text:
ash: heads-up — noticed odd churn in eviction counters on prod-llm pool last 6h, but only for small-key fragments. overall hit_rate steady ~0.92 but memory growth on long contexts keeps creeping up. graph: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/kv-overview

eva: uhh that's worrying. is eviction_total spiking or are we seeing long residency tails?

ash: eviction_total spikes correlate with higher seq-len sessions. average residency for small fragments dropped from 0.65->0.3 in last 24h. prometheus query I used:```sum by (shard, model) (rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) / sum by (shard, model) (kv_residency_gauge)``` rough but shows skew

benji: can you paste raw queries? might be sampling bias — our telemetry sampler drops some paging events when collector backlog is high.

ash: ```# per-shard eviction rate
sum(rate(kv_evictions_total{pool="prod-llm"}[5m])) by (shard)
# residency gauge snapshot
avg_over_time(kv_residency_gauge{pool="prod-llm"}[15m])```

maria: quick Q — is this limited to one model or many? if many, likely runtime algo. if one model, maybe tensorization/kv-layout difference.

ash: mostly 2 models (gptx-small, redwood-chat-7b) but more pronounced on gptx-small. fragmentation metric (kv_fragmentation_ratio) up ~12% on those shards.

eva: that points to uneven eviction bucket sizes. small-key fragments being evicted more frequently => fragmentation + tail memory growth as we keep hot large keys pinned.

benji: hypothesis: our hybrid eviction policy (LRU per slot, global age bucketing) interacts badly with continuous batching that favors short sequences — causes rapid churning of prefix fragments. telemetry sampler currently only emits kv_evictions_total for full-page evictions, not micro-evictions.

nate: I ran a perf profile earlier; attaching short summary: perf-bot posted 1785554500 - profiles show frequent list node churn in kv-heap for small-key entries. Link: https://perf.redwood.example/runs/1785554500

perf-bot: automatic note — flamegraph shows 22% time in eviction path for those shards during spike window.

maria: OK can we get two quick actions: (1) increment eviction sampling to 100% for prod-llm for 1h to capture micro-evictions; (2) add eviction_age histogram and per-model eviction counters to the dashboard. I'll own dashboard changes.

benji: I'll flip sampler to full for prod-llm now (will add extra cardinality). leaving note: may hit prometheus scrape limits.

ash: thanks — toggled via /runbook sampler toggle prod-llm 100% :gear:

eva: for dashboard: suggested panels — eviction rate (by shard), eviction_age_histogram, fragmentation_ratio trend, residency p50/p90/p99, and per-model reuse_ratio (reused_fragments / allocated_fragments).

maria: building panels. tentative alert: if eviction_rate/allocated > 0.3 sustained 10m AND fragmentation_ratio > 0.1 then page eng-runtime oncall. Thoughts?

benji: fine, but set noise filter for model-specific spikes. also add annotation for recent model rollout last night (rollout-2026-03-17).

nate: also propose a synthetic long-context load test to reproduce growth — will run a variant with mixed short/long seqs for 2h on staging.

ash: sounds good. action list: ash — validate queries + collect logs; benji — enable sampler (in progress) + add extra counters emitting; maria — update dashboard + create alert; nate — run synthetic test; eva — prototype small-key eviction policy tweak (guard micro-evictions behind min-residency).

maria: assigning owners in our tracker. ETA for dashboard + basic counters = EOD tomorrow.

ash: thanks team. will post follow-up with samples once sampler runs a bit. :thumbsup:
